number.why: HR 0.69 (0.60-0.80) is ARISTOTLE ISTH major bleeding, apixaban vs warfarin. It is not the death HR 0.89 in the same sentence or the major/CRNM endpoint. The registry confirms it in treated participants during treatment.

quotes.span: The rate of major bleeding was 2.13% per year in the apixaban group, as compared with 3.09% per year in the warfarin group (hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.60 to 0.80; P<0.001)

entry.why: Adults 18 or older with AF plus at least one stroke risk factor; the registry title restricts to nonvalvular AF.

quotes.span: Males and females ≥ 18 yrs with atrial fibrillation (AF)

missed: 'Non-valvular' rests only on the registry title. The held eligibility text has no valve exclusion criteria, and the registry CONDITION list includes atrial flutter. Neither changes the ruling.
